durable_planned_slot_replay.design: Persist scientific journal state rather than V3 cache state: ordered closed {predictable_weight,block_score} summaries plus at most one active pre-admitted block. Recovery reconstructs V3 by replaying closed summaries in order; an active block recovered at/after deadline closes fail-closed before further evidence is admitted.
durable_planned_slot_replay.conclusion: In the tested outage model, crash/restart and replay were decision-path identical to direct execution under the same operational availability history. Cache/root memo state is therefore not required as durable scientific state.

joint_iut_stress.result: For the frozen AND decision 'both channels are below tolerance', component tests can each run at global alpha and release only when both reject; no Bonferroni split is needed for that one intersection-union decision. In a toy two-e-process stress with dependence ranging from independent to fully shared Bernoulli draws, 100k-run fully shared checks gave false conjunctive-safe crossing 0.05065 when both means were exactly unsafe-boundary .05 and 0.05002 when one mean was .05 and the other .005. The small .05065 Monte Carlo excess is sampling noise around the theoretical level-.05 guarantee, not evidence of violation.
joint_iut_stress.timing_example: When both toy channels had mean .005 and 50% shared draws, both threshold-20 and threshold-40 rules crossed in all tested runs, but median stop was 73 versus 90 steps.
joint_iut_stress.scope: The no-split rule is for one conjunctive decision. Two displayed numerical upper bounds still need an explicit simultaneous-coverage construction if joint 95% coverage is claimed.

inherited_from_predecessor.streaming_v3: V3 passed interleaved append/query regression with zero decision mismatches and mandatory cache invalidation in ordinary and edge-weight streams.
inherited_from_predecessor.fail_closed_endpoint: Pre-admitted no-result slots score one and cannot be erased by late retry.
inherited_from_predecessor.ope_boundary: OPE policy value and predictable reliability weighting are different estimands except in explicitly matched special cases; current-outcome-dependent realized weights can move the target by an order of magnitude in the stored counterexample.
inherited_from_predecessor.trace_frontier: Public serving evidence still lacks the preferred same-fingerprint raw divergent output plus deterministic scorer dataset needed to measure token->score->paired-sign propagation directly.

measurement_validity_rules: Persist/replay scientific summaries, not numerical cache implementation details, when replay yields pathwise-equivalent confidence-sequence decisions.
Recovery after the frozen deadline must fail-close the active block before any later retry can change its planned-slot outcome.

A conjunctive safe-decision IUT can use each valid component test at alpha without multiplicity splitting because the unsafe null is a union; do not generalize this to joint confidence-bound coverage or arbitrary post-hoc combinations.
Simulation is a stress test of implementation/logic, not the source of the IUT error guarantee.
Keep OPE, predictable weighting, and realized-size weighting separated by estimand before comparing width or power.
scope_guards: No forbidden semantic inputs were read and no connector-discovery mutation occurred.
The crash/restart stress models JSON-like durable state and deterministic replay; it does not address malicious corruption or partial-write atomicity.
The joint IUT simulation uses simple Bernoulli e-processes, not the full V3 two-channel implementation.
All stress numbers are synthetic/local and are not production reliability measurements.
